description: A placed record Update.esm flags as deleted (REFR 000695FD) copied with overwriting over the whole version of Skyrim.esm that a new plugin got first (the GUI path, as in sse-copy-overwrite): the GUI asks whether to overwrite (Yes) and, as the source is deleted, answers No to the question whether to remove the target instead (remove_deleted false), so the deleted record is copied over the whole one: the target takes the deleted flag and the source's data, its editor ID is not set again.
